title: Implement Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) tracking (items, purchases/sales, vendor linkage, reporting & trends)

requirements.text: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints for COGS inventory items, including item name, default unit cost, and optional vendor linkage, with per-user ownership enforcement consistent with existing Expenses/Revenue authorization behavior.

quotes: Track individual items and their costs

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes create/update/delete/list query endpoints for COGS items.
Each item is owned by the caller; non-admin users can only read/write their own items.
Item can reference an optional vendor id (consistent with existing vendor IDs) and traps if a non-existent vendor id is provided.
Basic validation exists (e.g., name non-empty; costs are non-negative).

requirements.text: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints to record COGS purchases (inventory receipts) with date, item, quantity purchased, unit cost, and optional vendor, and enforce per-user ownership and validation.

quotes: Track item costs, quantities, and vendor information

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes create/update/delete/list query endpoints for COGS purchases.
Purchase records include: id, owner, date, itemId, quantityPurchased, unitCost, vendorId? (optional).
Validation prevents zero/negative quantities and negative costs.
Non-admin users can only read/write their own purchase records.

requirements.text: Add backend data models and CRUD endpoints to record COGS sales (inventory usage) with date, item, and quantity sold, and enforce per-user ownership and validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes create/update/delete/list query endpoints for COGS sales.
Sale records include: id, owner, date, itemId, quantitySold.
Validation prevents zero/negative quantities.
Non-admin users can only read/write their own sales records.

requirements.text: Implement backend COGS calculation endpoints that compute total COGS over a provided time window and return time-series trend data (bucketed by month) for reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides an endpoint to compute total COGS between a start and end timestamp (inclusive).
Backend provides an endpoint to return a monthly time series of COGS values over a requested range (each point includes period start and total COGS).
COGS computation uses recorded purchases and sales per item and is deterministic for the same underlying data (documented in code comments).
If there is insufficient purchase history for an item (e.g., sales with no purchases), the API returns a safe, well-defined value (e.g., treats missing cost as 0) and does not crash.

requirements.text: Replace the current static 'Coming Soon' COGS page with a functional COGS module UI that lets users manage items, record purchases and sales, and view computed total COGS and trends over time.

quotes: COGS tracking functionality is currently being developed.

acceptanceCriteria: /cogs no longer shows a coming-soon alert by default; it provides working UI for: Items, Purchases, Sales, and Summary/Trends.
Users can create/edit/delete items, purchases, and sales from the UI using dialogs/forms consistent with existing CRUD patterns in the app.
Vendor selection is available where applicable and is populated from existing vendors master data.
The page shows total COGS for a selected time window and a simple trend visualization (e.g., table or lightweight chart) using the backend trend endpoint.
All user-facing text on the COGS page is in English.

requirements.text: Extend the React Query data layer to support COGS items, purchases, sales, total COGS, and COGS trend queries/mutations, and ensure relevant screens refresh appropriately after mutations.

quotes: Track individual items and their costs

acceptanceCriteria: New hooks exist in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for listing and mutating COGS items, purchases, and sales, matching the patterns used for expenses and revenue.
After create/update/delete of COGS records, the COGS summary/trend queries and the dashboard query data are invalidated/refetched so UI stays consistent.
Loading and empty states are handled similarly to existing pages (spinner during load, clear empty-state messaging).

requirements.text: Integrate COGS into existing dashboard and reports so that KPI and report calculations use the computed COGS value and display it alongside revenue/expenses, including print views where applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard KPI 'COGS' displays the computed COGS for the selected time window instead of the current placeholder value.
Reports include a displayed COGS total for the selected report range, and net profit calculations incorporate COGS (i.e., net profit = revenue - expenses - COGS) in the report summary section.
Report output remains printable using the existing print flow.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing shadcn components instead).
Do not modify frontend immutable hook files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Use English for all user-facing UI text added/changed by this feature.
nonGoals: Implementing barcode scanning, recipe-level bill of materials, or ingredient-level depletion beyond the user-entered purchases/sales quantities.
Integrating external accounting systems or third-party inventory APIs.
Real-time collaboration or multi-user shared inventory beyond the current per-caller ownership model.
